payload.abstract: The present database is an ensemble of the cardiorespiratory measurements acquired during 992 treadmill maximal graded exercise tests (GET) performed in the Exercise Physiology and Human Performance Lab of the University of Malaga. Heart rate, oxygen consumption, carbon dioxide generation, and pulmonary ventilation are measured on a breath-to-breath basis along with the treadmill speed during maximal effort tests. Participants are amateur and professional athletes are of ages ranging from 10 to 63 years old. The age, height, and weight of the participants are provided, as well as the temperature and humidity during the test.
